metadata.title: Introduction to Fractions
metadata.subtitle: Sharing equally!
metadata.subject: Maths
metadata.author: Antigravity AI
learning_outcomes: Understand the concept of halves and quarters

ai_context.learning_goal: Introduce fractions as equal parts of a whole.
common_misconceptions: Thinking a bigger denominator means a bigger piece
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use pizza or chocolate bar analogies.

content.text: When you cut a pizza perfectly down the middle, you get 2 equal pieces. Each piece is called a HALF (1/2)!

content.question: If you share a chocolate bar equally with your friend, how much do you get?
content.explanation: You get one half (1/2), and your friend gets the other half!

content.text: If you cut that same pizza into 4 equal slices, each slice is called a QUARTER (1/4).

content.question: Which fraction is smaller?
content.explanation: A quarter is smaller because the pizza is cut into MORE pieces!
